description: NaLiTe is half-Heusler structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to four equivalent Li and four equivalent Te atoms. All Na-Li bond lengths are 3.00 Å. All Na-Te bond lengths are 3.00 Å. Li is bonded to four equivalent Na atoms to form distorted LiNa₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent TeNa₄ tetrahedra, corners with twelve equivalent LiNa₄ tetrahedra, and edges with six equivalent TeNa₄ tetrahedra. Te is bonded to four equivalent Na atoms to form TeNa₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent LiNa₄ tetrahedra, corners with twelve equivalent TeNa₄ tetrahedra, and edges with six equivalent LiNa₄ tetrahedra.
